title: NETL 2022 Case 2, CO2 compression and drying
source: NETL, Comparison of Commercial, State-of-the-Art, Fossil-Based Hydrogen Production Technologies (2022), Case 2, Exhibit 3-17/3-18 and equipment list
question: Build a DWSIM model of only Case 2's CO2 compression/drying train: mix captured CO2 streams 18 and 19, use multistage compression, intercooling/knockout as needed, approximate TEG dehydration with component_separator if needed, and final aftercooling. Given boundary stream 18: 30 C, 2.0 bar absolute, 69097 kg/h, mole fractions Carbon dioxide 0.9835 and Water 0.0165. Given boundary stream 19: 49 C, 1.4 bar absolute, 125180 kg/h, mole fractions Carbon dioxide 0.9728, Water 0.0270, Hydrogen 0.0002. The compressor is eight-stage in the published design; stage pressures and product conditions are withheld. Name the final outlet CO2_PRODUCT. Determine its temperature, pressure, total and component mass flows, compressor electric demand and final aftercooler duty. Do not use withheld pages or tune to their outputs. State every assumed stage ratio, outlet setpoint, dehydration recovery and efficiency and why. Run DWSIM and finish with a run label.
